…I cannot agree.

A squalid battle to the death like this is wrong.

……ああ、言われるまでもない。
俺は
「
戦わない。マスターの権利とやらをここで棄てる」
神父を見据え、はっきりと返答した。

pages.en:
“Well? Fight or refuse. Declare your choice here, Shirou Emiya.”

…Yes. He need not tell me.

I—

“—I won't fight. I surrender whatever right I possess as a Master.”

I meet the priest's eyes and answer without hesitation.

“What’s wrong? Will you fight or not? State now, Emiya Shirou.”
…He doesn’t even need to ask me.
I
“
I won’t fight. I’ll abandon my right as a Master.”
I look directly at the priest and answer.

「そうか。残念ではあるが、マスター本人の意思では仕方がない。衛宮士郎はマスターである権利を放棄し、聖杯戦争から離脱した。
それでいいな凛？」
「……？」
神父は俺にではなく遠坂に語りかける。

「……？」

pages.en:
“I see. Regrettable, but we must respect the Master's own will. Shirou Emiya renounces his rights as a Master and withdraws from the Holy Grail War. That is acceptable, Rin?”

“…?”

The priest addresses Tohsaka rather than me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. I’m disappointed, but it is the Master’s will. Emiya Shirou has abandoned his rights as a Master and withdrawn from the Holy Grail War.
Is that acceptable, Rin?”
“…?”
The priest addresses Tohsaka and not me.

pages.ja:
「構わないわ。それが衛宮くんの選択なら、わたしがどうこう言える事じゃないでしょう」
「……ふむ。その罪悪感だけでも収穫だったとするか。
では早速とりかかろう衛宮士郎。左腕を出したまえ」

“I have no objection. If that is Emiya's decision, it isn't my place to interfere.”

“…Hm. We shall count that guilt of yours as a harvest in itself.

“Let us begin at once, Shirou Emiya. Extend your left arm.”

“…Fine. What are you going to do?”

“It will be over quickly. I need only remove the Command Spells from your left arm.

“Two elements make a Master.

“The first is a contract with a Servant. The second is the Command Spells borne upon the arm.

“Once both are gone, you will be released from the Holy Grail War.”

There are two factors causing Masters to be Masters.

You will be freed from the Holy Grail War if you lose both of these.”

The stranger's fingers push wetly through my flesh.

It is simply that the priest's hand has become transparent as a ghost's and penetrated my body.

“A spiritual surgeon…?”

If I remember correctly, such practitioners heal the body by repairing its spiritual counterpart.

Their magecraft is said to be a kind of curse that removes tumors like a conjuring trick without making a single incision in the patient's body.

“Do not trouble yourself. The moment I mastered any form of magecraft, I became a failure as a priest.

“That being so, it makes no difference what art I prefer. Do not concern yourself with distinctions of dignity among magecraft.”

So it should not matter if the kind of magic I know is unfit for a priest. Do not worry about the type.”
